tools.name: build_product_lineage
tools.description: Build cradle-to-gate supplier lineage with hash-only claims and carbon aggregation. EU ESPR DPP.

tools.name: validate_fsma204_cte
tools.description: Validate required KDEs for FSMA 204 CTE types per the FDA Food Traceability List.

tools.name: link_traceability_lot_code
tools.description: Link TLCs across FSMA 204 CTEs, detect breaks, flag transformation new-lot events.

tools.name: validate_acp_checkout
tools.description: Validates ACP CheckoutRequest and CheckoutResponse payloads. Checks required fields, SPT structure, signature format, amount precision, currency codes, and agent-commerce-specific fields per the OpenAI/Stripe ACP specification.

tools.name: validate_c2pa_manifest
tools.description: Validate a decoded C2PA 2.x manifest structure: claim well-formedness, hard-binding hash assertion, and claim-signature reference. Structural validation only — does not verify the claim signature (see verify_content_credential_signature) or assert authenticity/provenance. Zero network, no state change, nothing issued or registered.

tools.name: verify_content_credential_signature
tools.description: Verify a C2PA COSE_Sign1 claim signature using crypto.subtle.verify (Ed25519/ES256/ES384/PS256). Cryptographic signature check only — trust anchor, cert-expiry, and revocation status are caller-supplied inputs, not independently checked by this tool. Zero network, no state change, nothing issued or registered. Emits ACCEPT or REFUSE.

tools.name: resolve_provenance_ingredient_tree
tools.description: Walk the c2pa.ingredient parent-of tree and confirm hashed_uri bindings and nested manifest hashes chain back to the active manifest. Emits intact/broken verdict.

tools.name: check_ai_act_art50_marking
tools.description: Check c2pa.actions for Art. 50(2) AI source-type marking adequacy and Art. 50(4) deepfake disclosure. Penalty: EUR 15M / 3% turnover. Applies 2 Aug 2026.

tools.name: verify_dual_layer_disclosure
tools.description: Confirm both C2PA signed metadata and an imperceptible watermark are declared present per EU Commission Code of Practice (Art. 50 multi-layer). Emits DUAL_LAYER_PRESENT or DUAL_LAYER_INCOMPLETE.

tools.name: validate_content_binding_assertion
tools.description: Validate hard-binding (tamper-evident asset hash match) vs soft-binding (watermark survives re-encode). Emits TAMPER_EVIDENT / SOFT_BINDING_ONLY / UNBOUND verdict. Terminal stage.

tools.name: verify_webbotauth_signature
tools.description: Verify an RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature for IETF Web Bot Auth (Ed25519). Reconstructs signature base from covered_components + signature_params, verifies via crypto.subtle. Zero network. Emits ACCEPT or REFUSE.

tools.name: validate_signature_directory
tools.description: Validate a /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory JWKS: path, all keys OKP+Ed25519, keyid resolution. Emits VALID or INVALID.

tools.name: validate_signature_agent_card
tools.description: Validate a Signature Agent Card: required fields + all card key IDs resolve against directory_keyids. Emits TRUSTED or UNTRUSTED.

tools.name: audit_agent_key_rotation
tools.description: Audit Ed25519 key age and rotation posture. Computes key_age_s, checks rotation_due and next-key staging. Emits HEALTHY / ROTATION_STAGED / ACTION_REQUIRED.

tools.name: crosswalk_agent_payment_rail_trust
tools.description: Crosswalk agent identity posture to Visa TAP, Mastercard Agent Pay, and Web Bot Auth. Per-rail {accepted, gaps[]}. Three rails checked.

tools.name: assess_agent_directory_publish_readiness
tools.description: Emit go/no-go directory publish-readiness for Web Bot Auth / Visa TAP / MC Agent Pay. Five boolean checks. ready = all true; gaps = failing keys list.

tools.name: validate_cyclonedx_sbom
tools.description: Validate a CycloneDX SBOM (bomFormat, specVersion, component name/version/purl, top-level dependencies) against the EU CRA Annex I machine-readable SBOM requirement. Feeds the SLSA provenance verifier (art-136). CRA SBOM mandate; full applicability 11 Dec 2027.

tools.name: validate_openvex_statement
tools.description: Validate an OpenVEX document: @context from openvex.dev, each statement has vulnerability, products[], valid status (not_affected/affected/fixed/under_investigation), and justification when status=not_affected. Zero network. Terminal node of sbom-provenance-attestation chain (art-135→136→137).

tools.name: validate_spdx_sbom
tools.description: Validate an SPDX SBOM (spdxVersion 2.x/3.x, SPDXID, package name/versionInfo/downloadLocation or purl externalRef, relationships) against the EU CRA Annex I machine-readable SBOM requirement. Feeds CRA Annex I completeness checker (art-139). Full applicability 11 Dec 2027.

tools.name: check_cra_annex1_completeness
tools.description: Check EU CRA (Regulation 2024/2847) Annex I essential requirements: sbom_present, sbom_machine_readable, top_level_deps_covered, vuln_handling_policy_present, secure_by_default, and conformity_route (self_assessment/eu_type_examination/full_quality_assurance). Returns gaps list. Second node of cra-product-conformance chain (art-138→139→140). Full applicability 11 Dec 2027.

tools.name: assess_cra_vuln_reporting_readiness
tools.description: Assess EU CRA Article 14 vulnerability reporting readiness: actively_exploited_detection, early_warning_24h_process, notification_72h_process, csirt_enisa_endpoint_configured, coordinated_disclosure_policy. Returns gaps list. Terminal node of cra-product-conformance chain (art-138→139→140). Art.14 obligations apply 11 Sep 2026.

tools.name: classify_nis2_entity
tools.description: Classify an entity as Essential, Important, or Out-of-Scope under NIS2 Directive 2022/2555 Annex I and II, applying sector codes, employee/turnover size thresholds, and automatic-essential carve-outs. Root node of the nis2-compliance chain.

tools.name: score_nis2_incident_significance
tools.description: Score a cybersecurity incident against NIS2 Article 23 significance thresholds. Returns significance_verdict (not_significant/significant/critical), triggering_factors, reporting_required, 24h/72h/30d deadlines, and notification recipients. Root node of nis2-incident-response chain.

tools.name: score_nis2_supply_chain_diligence
tools.description: Score ICT vendor supply-chain diligence against NIS2 Article 21(2)(d) and ENISA framework. Evaluates 7 controls: ISO 27001, incident history, audit clause, breach notification SLA, EU data residency, sub-contractor count, service availability. Returns risk_score, risk_tier (low/medium/high/critical), active_risk_flags, and remediation_checklist. Middle node of nis2-incident-response chain.

tools.name: audit_mcp_tool_scope_revocation
tools.description: Audit scoped and revocable MCP tool access: ungated grants, revocation endpoint presence, and token rotation status. Root node of the agent-authorization-lifecycle chain. Zero network.

tools.name: validate_mcp_task_lifecycle
tools.description: Validate long-running task state transitions per the new MCP spec state machine (working/input_required/completed/failed/cancelled). Caller supplies a JSON array of {from, to} transition objects. Terminal node of the agent-authorization-lifecycle chain. Zero network.

tools.name: check_emir_uti_completeness
tools.description: Validate EMIR Refit UTI format (ISO 23897, max 52 alphanumeric chars), generating-party LEI, and T+1 10:00 CET sharing timing. Caller supplies Unix timestamps for trade execution and UTI sharing. Returns format validity, deadline, and whether the T+1 SLA was met. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: validate_emir_upi
tools.description: Validate EMIR Refit UPI format (ISO 4914, 12-char alphanumeric via ANNA DSB) and product classification consistency: asset class must be IR/CR/EQ/CO/FX and instrument type must be present. Returns format and classification verdict. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: validate_emir_lifecycle_event
tools.description: Validate an EMIR Refit action type against the prior UTI state: New/Position on unreported, Modify/Correct/Valuation/Terminate/Error on open, Revive/Correct/Error on terminated. Returns validity verdict, allowed actions for the state, and rejection reason if invalid. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: run_emir_reporting_fit
tools.description: Grade a firm EMIR Refit reporting readiness across five dimensions: ISO 20022 cutover, UPI sourcing via ANNA DSB, UTI sharing SLA (10:00 CET T+1), reconciliation tolerance (148-field set), and lifecycle action controls. Returns A-F grade and gap list. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: validate_eudr_geolocation
tools.description: Validates EUDR Art. 9(1)(d) plot-level geolocation. Checks GeoJSON type eligibility (Point for <4 ha, Polygon for ≥4 ha), coordinate ranges [-180,180] lon / [-90,90] lat, and size rule conformance. Returns valid flag, issues list, and compliance flags.

tools.name: classify_eudr_commodity_scope
tools.description: Classifies HS code against EUDR Annex I commodities (cattle, cocoa, coffee, oil palm, rubber, soya, wood). Returns in_scope flag, commodity name, entity_role, SME/micro status, DDS obligation, and enforcement deadline.

tools.name: score_eudr_country_risk
tools.description: Score EUDR Art. 29 country benchmark risk tier (low/standard/high) to determine inspection rates and due-diligence intensity for supply-chain compliance.

tools.name: check_gpai_code_conformance
tools.description: Checks GPAI provider obligations under EU AI Act Art. 53 and Art. 55 systemic-risk obligations. Returns base_obligations_met, systemic_obligations_met (if applicable), overall_conformant flag, gaps list, and compliance flags.

tools.name: choose_cc_license
tools.description: Maps creator answers (waive all rights, allow commercial use, allow adaptations/share-alike) to the matching Creative Commons 4.0 license (CC0, CC BY, BY-SA, BY-ND, BY-NC, BY-NC-SA, BY-NC-ND). Returns license_id, spdx_id, license_url, required_elements, attribution_required. Deterministic decision tree. Selection only, not legal advice.

tools.name: select_cbe_license
tools.description: Rights-matrix lookup for a16z's six Can't Be Evil NFT licenses. Returns cbe_id, current_enum_name, launch_alias, license_version_index, arweave_uri (current and legacy), full rights matrix, and normative caveats. Deterministic decision tree. Selection only, not legal advice.

tools.name: map_pil_flavor
tools.description: Maps creator answers to a Story Protocol PIL flavor and emits the full PILTerms struct. Returns flavor, flavor_label, pil_terms (full struct), license_terms_id. Three flavors: non_commercial_social_remixing (licenseTermsId=1), commercial_use, commercial_remix. Selection only, not legal advice.

tools.name: generate_attribution_string
tools.description: Generates a human-readable TASL (Title/Author/Source/License) attribution line plus machine-readable ccREL JSON-LD and RDFa blocks for any Creative Commons licensed work. Not legal advice.

tools.name: validate_nft_metadata_art209
tools.description: Validates NFT metadata against ERC-721 and ERC-1155 required fields plus OpenSea metadata schema recommendations. Checks required fields, recommended fields, and license declaration. Not legal advice.

tools.name: compute_ipfs_cid
tools.description: Computes a deterministic IPFS CIDv1 (SHA-256 multihash, multibase base32) for any text input. Known vector: 'hello world' -> bafkreifzjut3te2nhyekklss27nh3k72ysco7y32koao5eei66wof36n5e.

tools.name: compute_llpa_stack
tools.description: Fannie Mae public LLPA (Loan-Level Price Adjustment) matrix calculator. FICO-by-LTV base grid plus feature surcharges: cash-out refinance, second home, investment property, warrantable condo, subordinate financing. Applies FTHB AMI waiver (SEL-2023-07, up to 1.75 pp reduction for first-time buyers at or below 100% AMI). Table version: FNM-LLPA-2025-11-01 (Fannie Mae public publication). Not check_agency_eligibility_matrix (DU/LPA approval grid) or check_conforming_loan_limit (FHFA size limits).

tools.name: compute_va_funding_fee_residual
tools.description: VA home loan funding fee (38 USC §3729) and residual income qualification. Funding fee table: first vs subsequent use, down-payment tiers (0%/5-9.99%/10%+), exemptions for service-connected disability/surviving spouse/Purple Heart. IRRRL: 0.50%. Residual income: VA Pamphlet 26-7 Ch.4 Tables 41A/41B by region (Northeast/Midwest/South/West) and family size; $80 per member above five. DTI benchmark: 41% (triggers residual income review when exceeded). Table versions: VA-FF-2025-01-01 (VA Circular 26-25-3); VA-PAMPHLET-26-7-CH4-2024.

tools.name: lint_mismo_uldd_ulad
tools.description: ULDD Phase 5 / ULAD structural lint of required data points, enumerations, and conditionality rules. Checks field presence against ULDD Phase 5 required set, validates enum values from the public Fannie Mae ULDD Phase 5 Data Stencil and Freddie Mac ULAD Data Dictionary v1.3, enforces ARM-conditional fields, range constraints, and indicator consistency. ULDD Phase 5 mandate effective 2025-07-28. Inputs are bounded structural fields only; loan PII never leaves the browser. Lints public ULDD/ULAD data dictionaries only; does not embed or validate against the membership-licensed MISMO v3.x Reference Model schema. Table version: ULDD-PHASE5-ULAD-1.3-2025-07-28.

tools.name: compute_disparity_metrics
tools.description: Computes three fair lending disparate impact metrics from aggregate lending counts: 4/5ths (80%) rule (adverse_impact_ratio) per EEOC 29 CFR §1607.4(D), z-statistic for statistical significance of the approval-rate difference, and standardised mean difference (Cohen's d). Inputs are aggregate counts only; no individual applicant records, names, demographic identifiers, or scores. ZERO PII BY CONSTRUCTION. EEOC Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures (29 CFR §1607), HMDA/Reg C.

tools.name: compute_hmda_rate_spread
tools.description: Computes the HMDA rate spread (APR minus APOR) per FFIEC methodology and classifies against HMDA reportability thresholds: 1.5 pp (first lien), 3.5 pp (subordinate lien), 6.5 pp (HELOC). Outputs rate_spread_pct, lien classification, is_reportable flag, and HPML indicator (1.5 pp first / 3.5 pp sub, triggers escrow and appraisal requirements under TILA). Table version: FFIEC-RATE-SPREAD-METHODOLOGY-2023.

tools.name: compute_scra_rate_cap
tools.description: Computes the SCRA 6% interest rate cap per 50 USC §3937 for pre-service loan obligations. Calculates covered months, excess interest, and forgiveness amount. Excess interest is always forgiven (not deferred) per 50 USC §3937(a)(2). Checks servicemember notification requirement. Flags SCRA_RATE_CAP_VIOLATION (original rate > 6%) and SCRA_NOTIFICATION_MISSING. Table: SCRA-50USC3937-2022.

tools.name: validate_pacs008_party_completeness
tools.description: Validates BIS CPMI d218 harmonised data requirements for a pacs.008 payment instruction: UETR UUIDv4 format, debtor and creditor names, BIC format, LEI format (presence and format; full mod-97 check-digit validation is in lint_lei_payment_binding art-246), and purpose code format. Outputs a CPMI d218 completeness score. Does not validate PostalAddress24 structure (use lint_cbpr_structured_address art-241) or PQC crypto readiness (use check_iso20022_pqc_readiness art-87).

tools.name: simulate_gpi_tracker_lifecycle
tools.description: Validates SWIFT GPI pacs.002 payment status code transitions against the GPI state machine (PDNG, ACSP, ACSP/ACWC, ACCC, RJCT) and checks the Universal Confirmation SLA (ACCC must be sent within 24 hours of ACSP). Detects invalid transitions, transitions from terminal states, and SLA at-risk or breached conditions. For use in agent-driven GPI payment monitoring workflows.

tools.name: compare_corridor_cost
tools.description: Benchmarks a remittance corridor total cost (fee % + FX margin %) against the World Bank Remittance Prices Worldwide (RPW) Q1 2026 snapshot for the same origin-destination pair, the SmaRT global average (6.36%), and the SDG 10.c 3% target. Reports meets_sdg_target, vs_rpw_benchmark, cost_at_200_usd, and cost_at_500_usd. For stablecoin corridor all-in economics use model_stablecoin_corridor_economics (art-250). For Reg E disclosure arithmetic use compute_remittance_disclosure (art-248). ZERO PII: corridor codes, amounts, and rates only.

tools.name: validate_openids_homeowners_record
tools.description: Validates homeowners insurance data records against the openIDS Homeowners Data Standard v1.0 (AAIS / Linux Foundation, November 2025) -- the first free open (Apache-2.0) insurance data standard. Checks required sections (policy, insured_location, coverage, premium), required fields per section, policy type (HO-1..HO-8, DP-1..DP-3), date ordering, payment plan, construction type, coverage limit positivity, and PII field detection. NOT an ACORD validator -- ACORD XML/AL3 is membership-licensed and is not referenced or reproduced here. ZERO PII: structural/field validation only.

tools.name: parse_camt053_reconciliation
tools.description: Classifies ISO 20022 camt.053 BkTxCd entries by Domain, Family, and SubFamily per the CGI-MP camt.053 Usage Guide v5.0 and the ISO 20022 ExternalBankTransactionCode1Code registry 2023-03. Validates the OPBD + sum(movements) = CLBD balance equation. Scores structured-remittance match rate. Emits reconciliation_status (CLEAN / PARTIAL_MATCH / LOW_MATCH_RATE / FAILED_BALANCE), match_rate_pct, and domain_buckets[]. Used in corporate TMS straight-through reconciliation. ZERO PII: no account-holder names or identifiers enter this kernel.

tools.name: score_cash_forecast_accuracy
tools.description: Scores treasury cash forecast accuracy per AFP Cash Forecasting Survey 2024 benchmarks. Computes MAPE and directional bias across T+1/T+7/T+30/T+90+ horizon buckets. Detects persistent timing bias (>75% same-sign errors over >=4 observations). Returns overall_accuracy_tier (EXCELLENT <5% / GOOD 5-10% / ACCEPTABLE 10-20% / POOR >20%), by_horizon breakdown, and timing_bias_detected. ZERO PII: aggregate monetary amounts only, no account-holder identifiers.

tools.name: check_producer_license_reciprocity
tools.description: Checks NAIC producer license reciprocity for non-resident filing across target states per MDL-218 and NIPR Reciprocity Matrix 2024. Returns all_reciprocal (bool), non_standard_states[] (CA, FL, NJ, NY, HI, MN, WI -- require independent filing), and coverage_by_target[] with per-state reciprocal flag, LOA gaps, and independent-filing notes. State codes and NAIC LOA enum codes only. No National Producer Numbers. Zero PII by construction.

tools.name: compute_cdd_ownership_25pct
tools.description: Recursive indirect natural-person beneficial ownership computation via ownership-tier multiplication. 25% threshold per FinCEN CDD Rule 31 CFR 1010.230 bank KYB customer due diligence. Returns is_beneficial_owner (bool), total_indirect_pct, and per-natural-person breakdown. Exactly 25% IS a beneficial owner (>=25 threshold). NOT the CTA/BOI domestic reporting rule (31 USC 5336) removed by FinCEN IFR 2025-03-21. For OFAC 50%-Rule sanctions aggregation see art-91-ownership-50pct-aggregator. Synthetic entity IDs only. Zero PII by construction.

tools.name: compile_work_mandate
tools.description: Compiles a §22 Work Mandate document into a deterministic §21.4 gated-chain config. Transforms scope.tool_ids (or scope.chains) into an ordered steps[] skeleton, maps conditions into gate rules (op/value/next), and maps escalation_triggers into rules whose next routes to the reserved 'escalate' target (§22.3). All conditions and triggers must share one RFC 6901 pointer per §22.4 Rule 2; multi-pointer policies are rejected with error:'multi_pointer_gate'. Default for every gate is 'escalate'. Same mandate always produces byte-identical config (deterministic, hash-stable). Not a payment-mandate builder, not an audit-mandate tool, not an agent-OBO validator -- this compiles a policy mandate into an enforceable gated-chain config. Zero PII: structural mandate fields only.

tools.name: verify_eth_state_proof
tools.description: Verifies an EIP-1186 (eth_getProof) account and storage Merkle-Patricia-Trie proof against a caller-supplied trusted state root using a pure-JavaScript keccak-256 plus RLP decoder and bounded trie walk. Zero-egress, no RPC call. Does not verify that the state root itself belongs to a real canonical block; consensus-proof (light-client header) verification is out of scope. Persona: fund administrator or auditor confirming tokenized-MMF or deposit-token holdings without trusting an RPC provider.

tools.name: lint_besu_settlement_contract
tools.description: Static conformance lint of a permissioned-EVM settlement contract (Solidity source or ABI) against six invariants: atomic PvP/DvP (paired-or-revert), no native-token/msg.value settlement dependence, a finality-hook/settlement event, a compliance-gate modifier preceding every value transfer, bounded participant-set loops, and upgradeability disclosure. Lightweight in-browser parse only, never solc, never a network call. v1 scope is source + ABI; bytecode/opcode heuristics are deferred. Not a security audit.

tools.name: check_linea_l2_finality_window
tools.description: Classifies a tokenized-deposit transfer’s finality risk given L2-batch to L1-settlement timing: soft (unsubmitted), batched (submitted, not yet final), or l1_final tier, reorg-window risk, and a safe-to-release verdict against a corridor policy cutoff. Fills the L2 gap classify_settlement_asset_finality does not cover. Classifies supplied state only, never observes the chain or an RPC. Draft-pinned generic optimistic/batched L2 model; Linea-specific published finality windows were not found at STEP-0 re-verify (2026-07-13). Not check_cash_leg_finality or classify_settlement_asset_finality.

tools.name: route_einvoice_jurisdiction_mandate
tools.description: Route a transaction to its applicable e-invoicing mandate regime, format, phase status, and transmission channel via a version-pinned mandate table keyed on supplier/buyer country, transaction type, and transaction date. Covers France (PDP, live 2026-09-01), Germany (XRechnung), UAE (PINT-AE pilot), Malaysia (MyInvois), Belgium (Peppol BIS 3.0, mandatory since 2026-01-01), Poland (KSeF FA(3), mandatory-use phase-in from 2026-02-01). Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: validate_a2a_trust_chain
tools.description: Validates an A2A v1.0 agent-card.json then assesses the delegated-authority trust chain into KYA-OS attestation and spend policy. Checks card schema, signature block, extension URIs, delegation depth ≤ 4, no scope escalation across hops, validity windows ≤ 90 days, no expired links, and spend-policy caps. Issues a unified PASS/WARN/FAIL trust determination and a single OpenChainGraph execution_hash receipt (chain_depth: 0, root). GPU: No.

tools.name: simulate_var_monte_carlo
tools.description: Monte Carlo portfolio Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall over a one-factor correlated-asset model. Integer xoshiro256** PRNG, fixed-point arithmetic throughout — a declared seed replays byte-identically, a tampered seed does not. Declares SPEC.md §24.6.2 'seeded-stochastic' determinism class. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: score_payee_name_match
tools.description: Deterministic, versioned single-pair payee name-matching score for VoP/CoP evidence. Normalizes (diacritics, legal-entity suffixes), scores by integer Levenshtein edit distance, bands MATCH/CLOSE_MATCH/NO_MATCH against declared thresholds. algorithm_version carried in the receipt. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: lint_cbom_structure
tools.description: Validates a pasted CycloneDX 1.6 Cryptography Bill of Materials against a hand-derived field subset and classifies declared algorithm assets as quantum-vulnerable or CNSA-2.0 target-aligned. Structural lint only, every finding asserted. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: validate_tempo_zone_disclosure
tools.description: Maps a Tempo Zone's party-visibility model (operator-sees-all / users-see-own / outsiders-see-ZK-proofs) against AML/audit/regulator disclosure obligations. Confirms TIP-403 freeze/allowlist propagates cross-zone. Issues a privacy-and-auditability attestation for the board/regulator. Verdict: FULL_ATTESTATION / PARTIAL_ATTESTATION / INSUFFICIENT. ISO 20022 pacs.008-subset artifact. Zones live June 2026; payroll/treasury first use case.

tools.name: compute_cyber_incident_notification_clock
tools.description: Starts three parallel regulatory notification-deadline clocks from one hash-anchored cyber-incident determination timestamp: the 36-hour interagency banking-regulator rule (12 CFR 53/225/304), the 4-business-day SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05 notification (weekends-only business-day arithmetic; no federal holiday calendar is applied, a documented scope limit), and the 72-hour NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500.17(a) notice. Each obligation carries its own decision-tree attestation slot (applicable, deadline, completion state, a §22.11-shaped optional exception for an at-risk or missed deadline) and a stable obligation_id ready to be cited by a future Human-Accountability (BANK-SPEC-HA-1) approval record, without embedding a mutable reference inside its own hashed output. A pending SEC Item 1.05 rescission petition (flagged Apr 2026) is carried as an annotation only; it does not alter the computed deadline. Complementary to tools/incident-response-runbook-builder.html. This tool computes deadlines and attestation slots only; it does not itself transmit, file, or submit any regulatory notification, and it is not legal advice.

tools.name: classify_dora_ict_incident_and_clock_deadlines
tools.description: Classifies an ICT-related incident as major or non-major under DORA (EU 2022/2554) Art. 18, applying the published RTS (EU 2024/1772) numeric criteria (clients affected %, duration, geographical spread, data losses, economic impact, critical-services impact, reputational impact), then starts the DORA Art. 19 reporting clock (4-hour initial notification, 72-hour intermediate report, 1-calendar-month final report, all from classification) once classified major. Follows the art-428-cyber-incident-clock deadline-clock pattern for the EU DORA regime; see that node for the analogous US banking/SEC/NYDFS clock. Not a duplicate of the existing art-09-dora-incident-classifier (earlier draft-RTS citation, no notification-clock link, infrastructure_mandate) -- art-467 cites the final 2024 RTS/ITS package and is built to the attestation-clock pattern; the overlap between the two is flagged for review, not hidden. This node classifies and computes deadlines only; it does not itself transmit, file, or submit any regulatory notification, and it is not legal advice.

tools.name: estimate_ficc_margin_netting
tools.description: DV01-bucket VaR proxy of the FICC VaR-based margin (VBM), the netting benefit of central vs bilateral clearing, cash-vs-repo cross-product netting, and the done-away uplift. Educational proxy - not the official FICC VBM calculator.

tools.name: estimate_cross_margin_benefit
tools.description: Estimates the initial-margin reduction from the FICC-CME cross-margining arrangement (customer expansion per SEC notice published 2025-12-22) by offsetting UST cash/repo DV01 against CME Treasury/SOFR futures DV01. Educational proxy.

tools.name: run_digital_trade_fit
tools.description: 12-question A–F readiness diagnostic for digital trade / electronic trade documents (MLETR). Grades corridor legality, document digitisation, platform connectivity, trade-rule basis (eUCP/URDTT), financing, and AML/TBML controls; routes to the right chain and emits a remediation checklist.

tools.name: validate_mletr_record
tools.description: Validates an electronic transferable record (eBL or other ETR) against MLETR functional-equivalence tests (Arts. 10–12: singularity, control, integrity, reliability) and scores cross-corridor legal enforceability from the UNCITRAL adoption status. Answers: will this eBL hold up at both ends of the corridor?

tools.name: run_slate_reporting_fit
tools.description: Score a caller-declared covered-securities-loan reporting pipeline against 5 boolean FINRA Rule 6540 obligation-checklist dimensions: reporting-agent registration, same-day capture, field-spec mapping, unique loan-identifier scheme, and recordkeeping retention. Returns an A–F grade and a list of gaps. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: record_index_constituents
tools.description: Gives an index's constituent set, as of a stated date, its own citable execution_hash -- the BMR/SEBI-shaped starting point ('what was in the index and why') that every downstream weighting or rebalance artifact cites rather than re-declaring. Attests that a declared constituent set exists exactly as stated, selected under a stated eligibility-criteria description, over caller-supplied constituent rows (security_id, name, sector, country) and a declared selection universe size. HARD FENCE: every constituent row and the eligibility-criteria description are supplied and asserted, never fetched (zero-egress); this attests THAT a declared set exists as stated, never whether the criteria was correctly applied against underlying market data, never a live index-provider feed. First entry of the Financial Index/Benchmark Administrator Lineage family, alongside the forthcoming compute_index_weights, compile_rebalance_evidence_pack and record_index_correction. Not fund NAV recomputation (art-373) or any benchmark-publisher scorecard. Corrections cite the prior artifact via the SPEC.md top-level supersedes field, not a bespoke status registry. EU Benchmark Regulation (BMR, Regulation (EU) 2016/1011) and SEBI benchmark-administrator framework citations informative only.

tools.name: record_fund_positions
tools.description: Gives a fund's declared positions snapshot, as of a stated valuation date, its own citable execution_hash -- the upstream input-receipt that the proven NAV chain (art-373-recompute-fund-nav) currently hashes internally, and that a separate wiring node can instead cite via an optional positions_ref rather than re-declaring the same holdings. Attests that a declared snapshot exists exactly as stated, over caller-supplied holdings rows (security_id, quantity, currency) and a declared shares_outstanding. HARD FENCE: fund_id, valuation_date, every holding row, and shares_outstanding are supplied and asserted, never fetched (zero-egress); this attests THAT a declared snapshot exists as stated, never whether it matches a custodian record, never a live position feed. Section 25 private-inputs review ruled not applicable and stated explicitly: holdings are echoed in cleartext by design, since the node's function is to give the declared snapshot a citable hash, not to hide it behind a commitment. Not fund NAV recomputation (art-373) and not a pricing input (a sibling record_pricing_inputs node covers pricing). Corrections cite the prior artifact via the SPEC.md top-level supersedes field, not a bespoke status registry.

tools.name: run_tokenized_settlement_fit
tools.description: 12-question A-F readiness diagnostic for wholesale tokenized settlement (tokenized deposits, central bank money, regulated stablecoins as settlement assets). Grades settlement-asset choice, finality regime, cross-network atomicity, asset-leg type, cash-leg issuer, intraday liquidity, and reconciliation controls; routes to the right wholesale-settlement chain and emits a remediation checklist.

tools.name: oracle_price_aggregation
tools.description: Computes an oracle aggregate price from supplied submissions under a named aggregation mechanism, optionally citing the prior print of the same pair. Aggregation step only, zero egress, every submission supplied and asserted.

tools.name: classify_emir3_simm_approval_scope
tools.description: Classify which EMIR 3 initial-margin model-approval obligations apply to a declared counterparty profile: NCA prior authorisation, EBA central pro forma validation, the recurring annual application-data update, and the 2026 EBA onboarding window. Zero ISDA SIMM methodology content.

tools.name: check_genius_reserve_disclosure_conformance
tools.description: Checks a monthly PPSI reserve disclosure against two statute-derived GENIUS Act S.394 §4 requirements: 1:1 reserve coverage arithmetic and attestation presence/timeliness against the statutory monthly cadence. Verdict per requirement (MET/NOT_MET/INDETERMINATE). NARROWED 2026-08-07: the permitted-asset composition check is out of scope because no final GENIUS Act implementing regulation exists as of that date (all OCC/FDIC/Treasury/FinCEN/NCUA instruments remain NPRM/ANPRM). Never claims final-rule attribution or compliance certification. Cross-links the shipped pre-issuance precheck_reserve_attestation (art-06) and the fuller check_genius_reserve_disclosure (art-275).

tools.name: recompute_x402_eip712_digest
tools.description: Recomputes the EIP-712 digest (domain separator, struct hash, final digest) for an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization struct from caller-supplied domain and authorization fields. All domain fields mandatory, never defaulted. No signature recovery, no settlement claim.

tools.name: verify_x402_signer_recovery
tools.description: Recovers the ECDSA signer address from an EIP-712 digest and a signature (r,s,v or r,s,yParity, with v/EIP-155 normalization), and compares it against an optional claimed from address. No hand-rolled crypto; recovery via the vendored, pinned noble-curves bundle. Malformed signatures produce a structured refusal, never a thrown error. No settlement or spend claim.

tools.name: check_x402_domain_nonce_window
tools.description: Checks an EIP-3009 authorization's domain (expected vs. signed chainId/verifyingContract, hard refuse on mismatch), validAfter/validBefore window against a caller-supplied now_unix, and nonce format. Accepts an optional caller-supplied nonce_already_used flag. Never queries a chain.

tools.name: check_webbotauth_nonce_replay
tools.description: Check a Visa TAP-shaped nonce for format, freshness against an 8-minute created/expires window, and an optional caller-supplied seen-nonce record. Stateless — replay prevention depends on the caller's own storage.

tools.name: build_ap2_cartmandate_hashchain
tools.description: Builds a deterministic hash-chain over an ordered cart_items array for an illustrative AP2 CartMandate VDC, or re-verifies a prior chain's links against a (possibly tampered) cart_items and reports whether it is intact plus the earliest divergent index.

tools.name: correlate_ap2_cartmandate_x402
tools.description: Correlates a built AP2 CartMandate against an x402_spend_evidence pack: cart total vs authorization value, merchant vs authorization recipient, and an independently re-derived cart hash-chain check. CORRELATION_STATUS vocabulary only (CORRELATED/NOT_CORRELATED/INDETERMINATE) -- never implies cryptographic binding.

tools.name: digest_gleif_snapshot
tools.description: Hash-pin a pasted GLEIF Golden Copy record or file segment as of a caller-stated capture time. The digest covers the raw pasted bytes, never a parsed or re-serialized form. Reads LastUpdateDate only from the CDF XML element; for a CSV row the caller states it. Validates LEI syntax as a courtesy flag (ISO 17442 mod-97), never as a blocking gate. Zero network: the GLEIF URL is named, never fetched. Not a statement that the record is still current and no ongoing monitoring duty.

tools.name: run_agent_economy_fit
tools.description: 12-question A-F readiness diagnostic for the agent-economy runtime / post-trade layer (x402 V2 batch settlement, AP2 PaymentReceipt, Human-Not-Present autonomy, reconciliation, metering, runtime fraud). Grades an agent platform/operator and routes to the right agent-economy chain.

tools.name: check_lei_relationship_consistency
tools.description: Check four structural invariants over a pasted set of GLEIF Level-2 relationship records for one subject LEI: node LEI validity (ISO 17442 mod-97), no direct-parent cycle, exception-code well-formedness against a versioned constant, and no overlapping duplicate active edges. A violation flags a possible inconsistency in GLEIF's published data, never a statement about the entity's actual corporate structure. An empty record set returns consistent:null, not a clean pass. Zero network.

tools.name: verify_merkle_airdrop_proof
tools.description: Recomputes a Merkle airdrop-claim proof from a declared leaf (address, amount) and sibling path to a claimed root, OpenZeppelin MerkleProof.verify shape, and optionally re-verifies a prior proof trace to report the earliest step where a recompute diverges.

tools.name: classify_erc1967_proxy_slot
tools.description: Recomputes the four canonical EIP-1967 storage slots (bytes32(uint256(keccak256(label)) - 1) for the implementation, admin, beacon, and rollback labels) fresh on every call using the vendored keccak256 bundle already pinned in this repository, then classifies a caller-supplied (declared_slot, storage_value) pair: which of the four roles declared_slot matches, if any, and whether storage_value looks like the zero-padded 20-byte address EIP-1967 expects at that slot (extracting and EIP-55 checksumming the embedded address when it does). Zero network calls: this tool never reads live chain state -- declared_slot and storage_value are both caller-supplied, read by the caller from their own eth_getStorageAt call or a block explorer, and may already be stale by the time they are pasted in. Address/slot-level fact only: renders no upgrade-safety, admin-trustworthiness, or implementation-safety judgment, and a non-standard declared_slot does not itself prove a contract is not a proxy.

tools.name: calculate_erc2981_royalty
tools.description: Recomputes an ERC-2981 royalty amount as floor(sale_price * royalty_fraction_bps / 10000) -- the same integer-division convention the OpenZeppelin reference ERC2981 implementation uses -- from a caller-declared sale_price and royalty_fraction_bps, using BigInt arithmetic throughout so a sale_price beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER never loses precision. Flags a bps value above 10000 (100%) as out of range (the value the reference implementation reverts on) while still reporting the raw recompute, and compares against an optional claimed_royalty_amount. Zero network calls: this tool never queries a contract's actual royaltyInfo() return value -- sale_price, royalty_fraction_bps, and receiver are all caller-declared. Cross-links 528-nft-metadata-validator and 521-cant-be-evil-nft-license-picker for adjacent NFT-standard surfaces (metadata shape, license terms) this tool does not cover. ERC-2981 royalty payment is a voluntary off-chain convention: this tool makes no claim that any marketplace will actually pay the computed amount.

tools.name: check_jwks_pinned_directory
tools.description: Confirms a caller-supplied JWKS directory document matches a caller-pinned SHA-256 digest, before art-130 trusts its shape. Zero network, zero key hosting -- both inputs are caller-supplied.

tools.name: recompute_erc4626_vault_share_math
tools.description: Recomputes ERC-4626 vault share/asset conversions from declared vault state under the rounding directions the standard mandates per function, plus a deposit-then-redeem round-trip loss bound, exchange-rate drift between two snapshots, and a declared fee application.

tools.name: recompute_erc4337_userop_math
tools.description: Recomputes the ERC-4337 userOpHash under a declared EntryPoint version (0.6 or 0.7), computes the required prefund from caller-supplied gas limits, and reconciles a declared paymaster charge against one recomputed from declared inputs. Never derives L1 data or blob fees and never fetches block.basefee. Zero network calls, no settlement claim.

tools.name: decode_eip7702_authorization_tuple
tools.description: Recomputes the EIP-7702 authorization-tuple hash from declared (chain_id, address, nonce), recovers the ECDSA signer, and reports the address-only fact of the delegate the EOA is authorizing. Never judges the delegate's code. chain_id=0 (cross-chain) is disclosed, not treated as an error. No hand-rolled crypto; recovery via the vendored, pinned noble-curves bundle. Malformed input produces a structured refusal, never a thrown error. No on-chain-submission or settlement claim.

tools.name: classify_mla_charge_inclusion
tools.description: Classifies whether a given charge type must be included in the Military Lending Act MAPR under 32 CFR 232.4(c) and 232.4(d). Returns included_in_mapr as true, false or conditional, the exact paragraph cited, a plain basis sentence, conditional_limit_usd where the regulation names a figure, and manual_review_required with a reason on the one cell the closed set cannot resolve. Performs no arithmetic and computes no MAPR.

tools.name: classify_codm_expense_significance
tools.description: Classifies one candidate segment expense under the ASU 2023-07 significant expense principle in ASC 280. Returns must_disclose_separately_50_26A, folds_into_other_segment_items_50_26B with the applicable ASC 280-10-50-26B buckets, outside_significant_expense_principle, separate_disclosure_required_50_22, the paragraphs cited and a basis sentence. Takes the significance assessment as a caller judgment and computes no benchmark, because the Update states none. Performs no arithmetic.

tools.name: classify_rate_rec_5pct_threshold
tools.description: Applies the ASC 740-10-50-12A(b) 5 percent quantitative threshold, as amended by ASU 2023-09, to one rate reconciliation item. Returns pct_of_threshold_base, crosses_5pct_threshold, must_disclose_separately, the required disaggregation for the declared category, and a named caveat where the threshold base is degenerate. Comparison is absolute value on both sides per BC35.
